question: Who caused the collapse of the Oct 4 talks?

sideA.label: Federal government
sideA.text: Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi said talks collapsed and blamed CM Sohail Afridi, saying he made several changes to a draft agreement and should have attended himself.

sideB.label: PTI
sideB.text: Salman Akram Raja said the deadlock stemmed from the federal demand that KP own anti-terrorism actions launched unilaterally by the centre.

resolution: Disputed; no independent account of the draft text.

question: Is the KP government failing on, or linked to, militancy?

sideA.label: Federal government
sideA.text: Information Minister Attaullah Tarar accused the PTI provincial government of links with terrorist groups; Islamabad cites militancy and deteriorating law and order.

sideB.label: PTI / Afridi
sideB.text: PTI calls the move political and unconstitutional; Afridi opposed federal counterterrorism measures as infringing provincial autonomy.

resolution: No public evidence for the links claim was found in reporting reviewed.

question: Was Afridi arrested or taken into protective custody?

sideA.label: PTI and aides
sideA.text: Described the detentions as arrests of Afridi and other leaders.

sideB.label: Police
sideB.text: Said Afridi and seven other leaders were taken into protective custody.

resolution: Terminology disputed; custody itself reported by police.

question: Is the KP emergency and governor's rule constitutional?

sideA.label: PTI
sideA.text: Rejected it as an unconstitutional assault on provincial autonomy and the public mandate; aide called it "a coup disguised as emergency".

sideB.label: Federal government
sideB.text: Cabinet recommended and the president approved it, citing law and order and militancy.

question: Was the PTI march peaceful?

sideA.label: PTI / Afridi
sideA.text: Afridi said the sole aim was a peaceful rally demanding Imran Khan's release.

sideB.label: Federal government
sideB.text: Tarar said PTI has a record of disruption and vandalism; Naqvi said no one would be allowed to storm the capital.

resolution: The march was halted by blockades and the emergency before reaching Islamabad; no violence was verified in reporting reviewed.
